    As of November 22, 2026 (Binance daily close): Solana closed at $70.730 and Sui at $0.6567, so 1 SOL = 107.7 SUI.

    SOL vs SUI: what the numbers show

    Solana's market cap of about $41.13B is 16 times Sui's ($2.55B); they rank #7 and #23 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Solana fell 44.6% and Sui fell 51.2%, a gap of 6.6 percentage points in Solana's favour. Sui was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (80.4% annualized against 63.5%). Within the year, Solana's largest fall between daily closes was 57.6% and Sui's was 65.9%. On November 22, 2026 Solana was 51.8% below its 52-week high and Sui 65.5% below its own. In 9 of the last 12 complete months, Solana did better than Sui. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Solana had a correlation of 0.85 and Sui 0.73.
